I’m sorry—I don’t have direct access to live clocks or external services, so I can’t tell you the exact moment‑to‑moment time right now.  

**Here’s what you can do instead**

| Option | How to get the time |
|--------|---------------------|
| **Your own device** | Most smartphones, laptops, and smartwatches display the correct local time automatically once their time zones are set correctly. |
| **Websites / Apps** | Sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york) or apps such as “World Clock” show up‑to‑minute accuracy for New York (Eastern Time Zone). |
| **Command line** | On Linux/macOS: `TZ=America/New_York date` will print the current NY time. |
| **Python snippet** | ```python\nimport pytz, datetime\nny_tz = pytz.timezone('America/New_York')\nprint(datetime.datetime.now(ny_tz))\n``` |

If you happen to know the current Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), just subtract four hours during U.S. summer months (EDT) or five hours during winter months (EST).
